title: Frontend: Project detail page — tabbed layout
description: Build the project detail page shell with a tabbed navigation (Overview, Timeline, Milestones, Todos, Journal, Parking Lot, Settings) and project header.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches project data on load, shows 404 if not found
Project header: name, type badge, status badge, level badge, points display
Active tab persists in URL (via ?tab=overview query param)
Each tab renders its corresponding section component
AI PM button in header to open AI chat panel

steps.details: Create src/pages/ProjectDetailPage.tsx. Fetch project using useQuery(['project', id], GET /api/projects/:id). Show loading skeleton, then render project header + Tabs. Use useSearchParams to sync active tab with URL.

Show: project name (large heading), type badge, status badge, level badge (e.g., 'Sprout'), points total. Action buttons: 'AI PM' (opens chat drawer), options dropdown (edit, delete). Progress bar component below header.

Use shadcn/ui Tabs. Tab values: overview, timeline, milestones, todos, journal, parking-lot, settings. Default to 'overview'. Each TabsContent renders the corresponding tab component (lazy/conditional render).
Navigate to /projects/:id. Verify header shows correct project data. Click each tab — verify content renders. Reload with ?tab=milestones — verify milestones tab is active.
